# Solar-generation test fixtures

Small excerpts of real responses, retrieved 2026-09-23, used by the offline tests.

- `ieso_gen_output_2024_excerpt.xml`: records copied unchanged from
  `PUB_GenOutputbyFuelHourly_2024.xml` (Independent Electricity System Operator,
  Generator Output by Fuel Type Hourly Report,
  https://reports-public.ieso.ca/public/GenOutputbyFuelHourly/); other days and hours were removed.
- `ieso_index_excerpt.html`: excerpt of the same directory's index listing.
- `open_meteo_toronto_2024-03-10.json`: Open-Meteo archive API response (ERA5, CC BY 4.0,
  https://open-meteo.com/) for latitude 43.6532, longitude -79.3832 on 2024-03-10 with the eight study variables.
